# X10 RF Options

!!! abstract "In this guide"
    Covers the RF Interface Options dialog for X10 RF interfaces, where you specify which house codes the interface monitors and optionally remap and retransmit received signals on the power line.

Indigo provides some advanced options for the various X10 RF interfaces (including the CM15 which is both Power Line and RF). Select `Configure...` from the `Interfaces->X10 RF` menu, then click on the `Interface Options...` button. You'll see the `RF Interface Options` dialog:

![X10 RF Options Image](../../../images/x10_rf_options.png)

This dialog will allow you to specify which X10 house codes the interface will respond to. You can also optionally have that house code remapped to another house code and retransmitted on the PowerLine.
